value.rationale: A natural complete two-parameter classification: all centered rectangles of fixed longest half-side and the entire locally integrable negative radial exponent regime. It locates a unique interior optimum despite failure of inclusion monotonicity in both directions, establishes a strict analytic correspondence between exponent and aspect ratio, and proves a nonperturbative essential-singularity limit with an independent sharp linear endpoint. These facts are not already implied by qualitative continuity or generic counterexamples.
